links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of LLM responses to periodontitis orthodontic patient questions
links.effect: All models produced university-level readability; DeepSeek-V3 most readable (FRE 33.61, FKGL 10.10); Claude-Sonnet-4 least readable (FRE 4.73, FKGL 13.72).
links.quote: All models produced responses with university-level readability.

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM patient-education responses versus recommended thresholds
links.effect: All models exceeded recommended readability thresholds for patient education; FKGL ranged from 10.10 (DeepSeek-V3) to 13.72 (Claude-Sonnet-4).
links.quote: All models exceed recommended readability thresholds for patient education.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates five commercial LLMs on patient-facing orthodontic questions regarding periodontitis using standard quality, reliability, and readability metrics, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
